description: Start a job to create a new Grid session.

csvFileHandleId.description: The ID of a fileHandle of a CSV that defines the starting state of the grid.  The first line of the CSV must be a header that defines the column names of the grid.

schema$id.description: The $id of the JSON schema to be used for model validation.  Note: If the $id includes a semantic version then specific version will be used.  If the $id excludes the semantic version then the latest version of that schema.
